Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"project_id\":55001,\"attachments\":[\"string\"],\"payment_application\":{\"commitment_billing_period_id\":20093,\"period_start\":\"2013-10-01\",\"period_end\":\"2013-10-31\",\"billing_date\":\"2013-10-31\",\"invoice_number\":\"ABC-1234\",\"origin_data\":\"XYZ-0012\",\"origin_id\":\"abc-123\",\"status\":\"under_review\"}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/prime_contracts/%7Bprime_contract_id%7D/payment_applications/%7Bid%7D", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
